title: checkout rejection log
description: demand signal logging for rejected checkout submits. deliberately excludes buyer identity fields: this is a demand signal per destination, not a user record. logged when no approved route exists for the destination, or listing-specific routing constraints eliminate all otherwise-eligible routes.

reason_code.description: machine-readable rejection reason. route_not_approved: destination is in shipping markets but has no approved routes. route_pending: destination is enabled but route predicates are under review. market_disabled: destination not in shipping markets file at all (default deny-by-default). listing_route_constraint: destination has approved routes, but listing's provenance or routing constraints eliminate every eligible route.

request_id.description: idempotency key from the purchase request. correlates rejection with the specific submit attempt.

country_code.description: destination country as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. the market for which routing was unavailable.

listing_id.description: the listing being purchased. required to understand which product demand signals come from.

created_at.description: utc timestamp when the rejection occurred. must end with Z, no timezone abbreviations.

phase_id.description: rollout phase id from shipping-markets.json when the market exists in the file. null when reason_code is market_disabled (destination absent from shipping markets entirely).
